meta.purpose: Scripted target-candidate Public Web Search fixture that returns candidate-specific profile links so manual E2E covers search, adjudication, materialization, and export with non-empty public_web_summary fields.

rules.name: target_candidate_public_web_candidate_links

result_templates.title: {candidate_name} - personal homepage
result_templates.snippet: {candidate_name} works on AI systems and product engineering at {company}. Personal homepage with projects, publications, and contact context.

result_templates.title: {candidate_name} - GitHub
result_templates.snippet: {candidate_name} builds AI tooling and developer infrastructure related to {company}.

result_templates.title: {candidate_name} - Google Scholar
result_templates.snippet: {candidate_name} publication and research profile with AI systems work at {company}.

rules.message: Scripted target-candidate Public Web Search returned candidate-specific profile links.

rules.name: target_candidate_public_web_candidate_profile_fallback

result_templates.title: {candidate_name} - GitHub
result_templates.snippet: {candidate_name} engineering and AI projects. Current company context: {company}.

rules.message: Scripted target-candidate Public Web Search returned a GitHub fallback profile.
